parameters.name: Availability_VM
parameters.query:
let StartTime = {TimeRange:start};
let EndTime = {TimeRange:end};
let SourceActivity =
    AzureActivity
    | where strcat("/subscriptions/", SubscriptionId) in~ ({subscriptionID})
    | where TimeGenerated between ((StartTime - 90d) .. EndTime);
let ActivityRows = toscalar(
    SourceActivity
    | summarize count());
let Inventory =
    arg("").Resources
    | where strcat("/subscriptions/", subscriptionId) in~ ({subscriptionID})
    | where type in~ (
        "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines",
        "microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets")
    | extend JoinKey = 1
    | join hint.remote=right kind=inner (
        print JoinKey = 1
    ) on JoinKey
    | project
        ResourceId = tolower(id),
        ResourceName = name,
        ResourceType = type;
let HealthEvents =
    SourceActivity
    | where CategoryValue in~ ("ResourceHealth", "Resource Health")
    | extend ResourceIdLower = tolower(ResourceId)
    | where
        (
            ResourceIdLower contains
                "/providers/microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/"
            and ResourceIdLower !contains
                "/virtualmachinescalesets/"
        )
        or
        (
            ResourceIdLower contains
                "/providers/microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets/"
            and ResourceIdLower !contains
                "/virtualmachines/"
        )
    | extend P = iif(
        isnotempty(tostring(Properties_d)),
        Properties_d,
        parse_json(Properties))
    | extend State = tostring(
        coalesce(
            P.currentHealthStatus,
            P.healthStatus))
    | where State in~ (
        "Available",
        "Unavailable",
        "Degraded",
        "Unknown")
    | project
        ResourceId = ResourceIdLower,
        EventTime = TimeGenerated,
        State;
union
    (
        Inventory
        | project
            ResourceId,
            EventTime = StartTime,
            State = "Available",
            Priority = 0
    ),
    (
        HealthEvents
        | where EventTime < StartTime
        | summarize arg_max(EventTime, State) by ResourceId
        | project
            ResourceId,
            EventTime = StartTime,
            State,
            Priority = 1
    ),
    (
        HealthEvents
        | where EventTime >= StartTime
            and EventTime < EndTime
        | project
            ResourceId,
            EventTime,
            State,
            Priority = 2
    )
| summarize arg_max(Priority, State) by ResourceId, EventTime
| project ResourceId, EventTime, State
| sort by ResourceId asc, EventTime asc
| serialize
| extend
    NextResourceId = next(ResourceId),
    NextEventTime = next(EventTime)
| extend IntervalEnd = iff(
    NextResourceId == ResourceId,
    min_of(NextEventTime, EndTime),
    EndTime)
| where EventTime < EndTime
| extend IntervalMinutes =
    todouble(
        datetime_diff(
            "second",
            IntervalEnd,
            EventTime))
        / 60.0
| summarize
    Resources = dcount(ResourceId),
    EligibleMinutes = sum(IntervalMinutes),
    UnavailableMinutes = sumif(
        IntervalMinutes,
        State =~ "Unavailable")
| where ActivityRows > 0
| extend Availability = iff(
    EligibleMinutes > 0,
    round(
        100.0 *
        (EligibleMinutes - UnavailableMinutes)
        / EligibleMinutes,
        4),
    real(null))
| project Availability

### Availability Detail AzureActivity contains Azure Activity Log records exported into Log Analytics.
For this Workbook, we use records where: `CategoryValue =~ "ResourceHealth"`.
These records describe changes in Azure’s assessment of an individual resource’s health.

#### Health states | State | Meaning | | -----| -----| | ✅ Available | Azure detects no issue affecting the resource | | ⛔ Unavailable | Azure detects that the resource cannot provide its expected service | | ⚠️ Degraded | The resource remains available but has reduced performance or functionality | | ⬜ Unknown | Azure does not currently have enough health information | #### Pre-requities ActivityLog data needs to be enabled to flow through to a Log Analytics Workspace.
This is the source of truth for this Workbook to query and surface relevant data.

    ) on VmId
    | project
        DiskId,
        EventTime,
        State;
union
    (
        DiskInventory
        | project
            ResourceId = DiskId,
            EventTime = StartTime,
            State = "Available",
            Priority = 0
    ),
    (
        DiskHealthEvents
        | where EventTime < StartTime
        | summarize arg_max(EventTime, State) by DiskId
        | project
            ResourceId = DiskId,
            EventTime = StartTime,
            State,
            Priority = 1
    ),
    (
        DiskHealthEvents
        | where EventTime >= StartTime
            and EventTime < EndTime
        | project
            ResourceId = DiskId,
            EventTime,
            State,
            Priority = 2
    )
| summarize arg_max(Priority, State) by ResourceId, EventTime
| project ResourceId, EventTime, State
| sort by ResourceId asc, EventTime asc
| serialize
| extend
    NextResourceId = next(ResourceId),
    NextEventTime = next(EventTime)
| extend IntervalEnd = iff(
    NextResourceId == ResourceId,
    min_of(NextEventTime, EndTime),
    EndTime)
| where EventTime < EndTime
| extend IntervalMinutes =
    todouble(
        datetime_diff(
            "second",
            IntervalEnd,
            EventTime))
        / 60.0
| summarize
    Resources = dcount(ResourceId),
    EligibleMinutes = sum(IntervalMinutes),
    UnavailableMinutes = sumif(
        IntervalMinutes,
        State =~ "Unavailable")
| where ActivityRows > 0
| extend
    Category = "Managed disks (VM proxy)",
    Availability = iff(
        EligibleMinutes > 0,
        round(
            100.0 *
            (EligibleMinutes - UnavailableMinutes)
            / EligibleMinutes,
            4),
        real(null))
| project
    Category,
    Resources,
    EligibleMinutes = round(EligibleMinutes, 0),
    UnavailableMinutes = round(UnavailableMinutes, 2),
    Availability
